categories.main_business_segments: SUN&L Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four segments: wood products (plywood, MDF, sawn timber, PB), furniture (wood windows, interior, built-in furniture), daily necessities (plastic packaging products such as pump dispensers and trigger sprayers), and other businesses including logging, forestry development, real estate leasing and development, construction services, and vehicle maintenance. The company has shifted from domestic production of plywood and MDF to import distribution due to market conditions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes manufacturing technologies for wood products including plywood, MDF, and sawn timber, with production facilities in Korea and previously in Myanmar and Vietnam. For daily necessities, it employs plastic injection molding and assembly technologies for pump dispensers and trigger sprayers, including advanced eco-friendly material development such as recycled polypropylene and bio-based resins. The furniture segment involves specialized production and installation techniques for wood windows, fire-resistant doors, and high-end imported kitchen furniture.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies for wood and furniture products, domestic and international distributors for wood and daily necessities, and major Korean cosmetics companies for plastic packaging products. The furniture segment serves large construction firms like DL E&C, Lotte Construction, GS Construction, and Doosan Construction. The daily necessities segment targets domestic cosmetics brands and exports to North America and other markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing plants in Incheon, Gyeongnam, Chungbuk, and overseas subsidiaries in Vietnam, China, Myanmar (undergoing liquidation), Canada, New Zealand, and Singapore. It has shifted some production to imports, especially for plywood and MDF, and maintains sales and distribution networks domestically and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: SUN&L operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, producing and distributing wood products, furniture, and plastic packaging components. It sources raw materials such as logs and plastic resins mainly through imports and manages manufacturing and assembly before selling to construction firms, distributors, and end consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on R&D for resin improvement, new product development, and performance testing, with an emphasis on eco-friendly and recyclable materials in the daily necessities segment. It invests in core mold technology for plastic injection and aims to develop silicone-free and bio-based resin products. The strategic direction includes strengthening business capabilities in daily necessities and transitioning wood product operations from manufacturing to import distribution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales across its segments: wood products (plywood, MDF, sawn timber), furniture (contracted construction and sales), daily necessities (plastic pump dispensers and sprayers), and other services such as real estate leasing and vehicle maintenance. Sales channels include direct sales, dealerships, and exports, with some internal transactions among subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the plywood market, competitors include Sungchang Enterprise and Igeon Industry, with SUN&L holding about 13.4% domestic market share. In MDF, competitors include Dongwha Enterprise, Unid, Hansol Home Deco, and Foresco, with SUN&L holding 16.3%. The company is recognized as a leading domestic manufacturer and supplier in wood products and a dominant player in the domestic pump dispenser market with an estimated 63% share. It is acknowledged for technological leadership in eco-friendly plastic packaging.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, SUN&L reported consolidated revenues of approximately 441.1 billion KRW, down 12.95% from the previous year, with an operating loss of 30.2 billion KRW and a net loss of 159.2 billion KRW. The company has total assets of about 628.1 billion KRW, showing a 19.77% increase mainly due to asset revaluation. The business has experienced challenges due to construction market downturns and increased import competition, leading to production suspensions in plywood and MDF segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SUN&L emphasizes high-quality, eco-friendly wood and plastic products with advanced technology such as recyclable pump dispensers and bio-based resins. Its furniture segment offers premium imported kitchen brands and specialized fire-resistant and hidden doors with superior installation techniques. The company leverages long-term raw material procurement strategies and proprietary mold technologies to maintain competitive pricing and product innovation, positioning itself as a leader in sustainable packaging and integrated interior solutions.
